config.label: SolarWinds Service Desk admin token (JWT)
config.description: SolarWinds Service Desk admin token (JWT). Generate in the SWSD UI: Setup -> Users & Groups -> Users -> [your user] -> Actions -> Generate JSON Web Token. Service Desk administrator rights required.

config.label: SWSD API base URL
config.description: SWSD API base URL. US tenants: https://api.samanage.com (default). EU tenants: https://apieu.samanage.com.

config.label: Tool registration profile: 'triage' (22 read-heavy tools), 'agent' (52 default), 'knowledge' (17 KB-author), 'operations' (146 every tool), 'custom' (explicit SWSD_TOOLS and/or SWSD_PROFILE_FILE selection)
config.description: Tool registration profile: 'triage' (22 read-heavy tools), 'agent' (52 default), 'knowledge' (17 KB-author), 'operations' (146 every tool), 'custom' (explicit SWSD_TOOLS and/or SWSD_PROFILE_FILE selection).

config.label: Write safety mode: 'live' calls SWSD normally; 'dry-run' returns write payload previews without sending writes; 'disabled' rejects write tools
config.description: Write safety mode: 'live' calls SWSD normally; 'dry-run' returns write payload previews without sending writes; 'disabled' rejects write tools.

config.label: Optional real-path boundary for local file_path attachment uploads over stdio
config.description: Optional real-path boundary for local file_path attachment uploads over stdio. Files outside this directory are rejected.

config.label: With SWSD_PROFILE=custom, comma-separated tool names (whitespace trimmed)
config.description: With SWSD_PROFILE=custom, comma-separated tool names (whitespace trimmed). Unioned with SWSD_PROFILE_FILE. Unknown names warn and are skipped; the resulting selection must be nonempty.

config.label: With SWSD_PROFILE=custom, absolute or startup-cwd-relative path to a JSON profile (version 1)
config.description: With SWSD_PROFILE=custom, absolute or startup-cwd-relative path to a JSON profile (version 1). At most 256 KiB; unioned with SWSD_TOOLS. See schemas/swsd-profile.schema.json.

config.label: Maximum downloaded attachment size in bytes (1–26214400); default 5 MiB
config.description: Maximum downloaded attachment size in bytes (1–26214400); default 5 MiB. Applies to read-only attachment retrieval.
